description: This file implements the cell metrics handler for a scheduler in a wireless communication system, including metrics collection, reporting, and management of UE (User Equipment) events and statistics.

classes.name: null_metrics_notifier
classes.description: A no-op notifier class that provides dummy metrics reports.

classes.name: cell_metrics_handler
classes.description: Handles collection, processing, and reporting of cell and UE metrics for a scheduler.

classes.name: scheduler_ue_metrics
classes.description: Data structure representing metrics for a UE.

methods.name: cell_metrics_handler::cell_metrics_handler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cell metrics handler with configuration.

methods.name: cell_metrics_handler::enabled
methods.description: Checks if the handler is enabled.

methods.name: cell_metrics_handler::handle_ue_creation
methods.description: Handles creation of a new UE entry.

methods.name: cell_metrics_handler::handle_crc_indication
methods.description: Handles CRC indications for UL transmissions.

methods.name: cell_metrics_handler::handle_ul_bsr_indication
methods.description: Processes UL BSR (Buffer Status Report) indications.

methods.name: cell_metrics_handler::handle_ul_phr_indication
methods.description: Handles UL PHR (Power Headroom Report) indications.

methods.name: cell_metrics_handler::report_metrics
methods.description: Generates and sends a metrics report.

methods.name: cell_metrics_handler::handle_slot_result
methods.description: Processes slot results and updates metrics.

methods.name: cell_metrics_handler::push_result
methods.description: Pushes slot result and triggers report if needed.

methods.name: cell_metrics_handler::ue_metric_context::compute_report
methods.description: Computes a report for a UE's metrics.

methods.name: scheduler_metrics_handler::add_cell
methods.description: Adds a new cell to the scheduler metrics handler.

methods.name: scheduler_metrics_handler::rem_cell
methods.description: Removes a cell from the scheduler metrics handler.
